quiz.question: What happens when an error is thrown and nothing handles it?

answers.answer: The error is silently ignored and code continues
The program crashes and the rest of the code never runs
The error is logged but execution continues normally
The program restarts automatically from the beginning

quiz.explanation: When an error is thrown and nothing handles it, the program crashes. The rest of the code never runs, which is why error handling exists.

quiz.question: Which of the following would throw an error in JavaScript/TypeScript?
quiz.explanation: JSON.parse throws an error when given invalid JSON. Operations like variable declarations, logging, and arithmetic do not throw errors on their own.
